(4) Support-pair peels: std 2.5/3.0/1.6/2.0, spatial_corr 0.992/0.996/0.976/0.989, rgb_ratio 1.43/1.67/2.02/1.74 (chroma-heavy only on colorful images -> content-proportional systematic difference, whereas additive YCrCb noise would be content-independent). final_decision.rationale: Single-step deterministic pipeline. Blur: gm_ratio target 0.1811 vs blur_gaussian:4 sim 0.181, spectral slope -1.644 vs -1.6506, FFT anisotropy 1.21 (<1.7 excludes motion), glass_score 0.058 (<0.25 excludes glass); PSNR severity scan {3:33.93, 4:35.61, 5:34.91} peaks at 4 and support pairs 3/4 reproduce >40dB with the same sev4. decision.rationale: No R1 candidate passes the validation rule. Control reproduces all 5 pairs (35.61-43.52 dB).
